AI-103 Flashcards

How this deck works

Every area of the exam, grouped by its domain and weight. Pick the best of four answers, or switch to flipping and saying the answer out loud. A wrong pick explains why it's wrong and what it belongs to. A right one moves to the next card after 1.5 seconds; click anywhere to stay and read. Every wrong answer goes into your review pile automatically, and + Add to review (or R) adds any card you want to see again; Review only drills that pile. Cards with a yellow edge and ★ test a skill named in the AI-103 study guide; use Study guide only to drill just those. Learn modules only keeps the cards whose topic is taught in the AI-103 Microsoft Learn modules and drops the ones that come only from other Microsoft docs. The counts on the chips follow whichever of these is on.

Concept cards are the ones to master. For Code cards, recognize the name and say what it does. Fill in the function shows real Microsoft sample code with one name blanked out: pick it from four choices (or switch to typing it), then press Enter for the next card.
